_comment: Auth settings merged into appsettings.Production.json on the web VM by Invoke-IntegrationTests.ps1 -Auth. Copy to appsettings.Production.json and fill in the AzureAd values.
_comment2: Authentication.Mode and WebJEA.DevAutoLogin are set from -Auth (AD, Entra, Dev); the values here are overwritten.

Entra._comment: EnableGraph requires AzureAd.ClientSecret and the GroupMember.Read.All delegated permission WITH ADMIN CONSENT, or Graph calls fail with AADSTS65001 (see docs/entra.md).

AzureAd._comment: Required for -Auth Entra. Redirect URI on the app registration: https://<WebServer.FQDN>/signin-oidc

DevUser._comment: Used by -Auth Dev. Sids are matched literally against PermittedGroups in webjea.json.
DevUser.Name: DOMAIN1\devtester
